original_sentence: The human race has done much harm.
readingExamples: The human race has done much harm.
definitionEn:
(1) n. physical, mental, or moral injury or damage caused to someone or something
(2) vt. to have a bad effect on someone or something; to hurt or damage
(3) n. the negative or undesirable consequences of an action
(4) vt. to cause injury or suffering to a living thing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 恶意，害人之心（多用于 mean sb no harm / there's no harm in doing）
uncommonMeanings.example: "I mean you no harm," the stranger said softly, lowering his hood to reveal a weather-beaten yet kindly face, and only then did the trembling child dare to lift her eyes. （读后续写·陌生人善意）

posExamples.sentence: As the flames crept closer to the nest, the mother bird beat her wings frantically, ready to do anything rather than let the fire harm the tiny lives huddled beneath her. （读后续写·母爱·危机时刻）
I am writing to appeal to every resident of our community: the careless dumping of plastic waste does untold harm to the river that has nourished us for generations. （应用文·倡议书）
While social media undeniably connects us across continents, the harm it inflicts on teenagers' attention span and mental health can no longer be ignored. （议论文·科技与青少年）
Excessive praise, though well-intentioned, may in fact harm a child's resilience by robbing them of the chance to learn from failure. （议论文·教育理念）

idioms.idiom: there is no harm in doing sth
idioms.example: There is no harm in asking for help; indeed, the courage to admit one's limits is the first step towards real growth. （议论文·成长心态）

idioms.translation: 在安全的地方，脱离危险
idioms.example: She gathered the frightened kittens into a cardboard box and carried them out of harm's way just as the storm broke overhead. （读后续写·救援·温情）
He meant no harm by the joke, yet the hurt in his friend's eyes taught him that words, once spoken, can never be taken back. （读后续写·友谊·教训）

collocations.example: Pouring untreated waste into the stream does lasting harm to the delicate ecosystem downstream. （应用文·环保倡议）
Loud, prolonged noise can cause serious harm to the developing ears of newborns. （议论文·公共健康）
The old shepherd stayed awake all night, determined that not a single lamb should come to harm. （读后续写·守护·责任）
Constantly comparing children with their peers often does more harm than good, quietly eroding their self-worth. （议论文·教育）
A well-designed fence along the cliff would protect careless hikers from harm without spoiling the view. （应用文·建议信）
The bodyguard threw himself in front of the singer, prepared to suffer physical harm rather than see her hurt. （读后续写·舍身相护）
"No harm done," the teacher smiled, wiping the spilt ink from the desk, and the boy's shoulders relaxed at last. （读后续写·宽容·师生）

collocations.phrase: keep sb from harm / away from harm
collocations.example: Ancient walls were built not to divide people but to keep the vulnerable within from harm. （议论文·历史反思）
Ignoring the early warning signs of the flood could have caused grievous harm to the entire village. （议论文·防灾）

synonyms.translation: 损害，破坏（尤指物体、财产、抽象事物）
synonyms.example: The typhoon caused extensive damage to the coastal town, leaving roofs torn and boats overturned. （读后续写·灾难场景）
synonyms.usage: 多指对物质、财产、名誉的具体破坏，程度可衡量；harm 更侧重对人、健康、生命的伤害，常含道德或健康色彩

synonyms.example: His careless words hurt her more deeply than any physical blow could have. （读后续写·情感冲突）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，兼指身体和情感的伤痛，主观感受强；harm 更正式、更客观，常用于健康、环境、利益语境

synonyms.example: Three passengers were injured when the bus skidded off the icy road. （新闻/读后续写·事故）
synonyms.usage: 特指身体上的、常为意外造成的伤，常用于事故报道；harm 范围更广，包含健康、利益、道德层面

synonyms.translation: 损害，削弱（尤指功能、能力）
synonyms.example: Staring at screens late into the night can seriously impair the quality of one's sleep. （议论文·健康）
synonyms.usage: 书面、正式，专指削弱某种功能或能力（视力、判断力、记忆）；harm 更通用、更口语可达

advancedExpressions.expression: resolve that no harm should ever come to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that trembling moment she resolved that no harm should ever come to the little brother sleeping in her arms — a vow forged not in words but in the fierce, silent beating of her heart. （名词性从句作宾语 + 破折号补充抒情，续写保护主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: every small act of carelessness does harm that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must never forget that every small act of carelessness does harm that accumulates, drop by drop, into a flood of irreversible destruction. （倡议书唤起责任感，定语从句 + 比喻累积）

advancedExpressions.expression: the harm ... poses is not immediate but insidious
advancedExpressions.example: The harm that unchecked consumerism poses is not immediate but insidious, gnawing quietly at the values a society holds dear until little of worth remains. （对比结构 not...but + 拟人 gnawing，深化论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The fire harmed many animals.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the wall of flames swept across the parched grassland, it harmed everything in its path — deer scattered in blind terror, birds abandoned their nests, and the very soil that had cradled a thousand lives was reduced to smoking ash. （读后续写·灾难·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 引导时间状语渲染进程 + 破折号后三组并列具象画面 + the very soil that... 定语从句强调对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: Plastic harms the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is beyond dispute that the plastic we so thoughtlessly discard harms the environment in ways we are only beginning to comprehend, threatening not merely today's oceans but the very future our children will inherit. （议论文·环保·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is beyond dispute that... 强调句式 + not merely...but the very... 递进强调 + 现在分词 threatening 作状语延展论证

original_sentence: We have polluted our soils and seas,
readingExamples: We have polluted our soils and seas,
definitionEn:
(1) n. the top layer of the earth in which plants grow, made of a mixture of minerals and decayed matter
(2) n. a country or region regarded as a territory or homeland
(3) vt. to make something dirty; to stain
(4) n. dirt or filth on a surface or on clothing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 弄脏，玷污（常引申为玷污名声/清白）
uncommonMeanings.example: He would rather starve than soil his hands with money earned through deceit — a stubborn pride that had cost him dearly, yet one he refused to abandon. （读后续写·人物气节·清白）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 国土，故土（on native / foreign soil 在本国/异国土地上）
uncommonMeanings.example: After twenty long years abroad, the moment his feet touched native soil the old sailor knelt and wept, pressing his weathered palms to the earth that had never left his dreams. （读后续写·游子归乡·思乡）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling in the garden at dawn, Grandpa let the dark, moist soil run through his fingers, and for a fleeting moment the years fell away and he was a boy again on his father's farm. （读后续写·祖辈·回忆）
I would like to propose that our class launch a tree-planting project, for even the most barren soil can be brought back to life through patient, collective effort. （应用文·倡议书）
A nation's culture, much like a plant, cannot flourish unless it is deeply rooted in the soil of its own history and traditions. （议论文·文化传承）
Decades of careless farming had stripped the soil of its nutrients, leaving behind a cracked, lifeless wasteland where nothing green would grow. （读后续写/议论文·环境退化）

idioms.translation: 在本国/异国/主场的土地上
idioms.example: Standing on home soil for the final, the young gymnast felt the roar of the crowd lift her like a wave. （读后续写·赛场·荣誉）

collocations.example: The valley's rich soil, watered by mountain streams, yielded harvest after golden harvest. （读后续写·田园·丰收）
Even in the poor soil of the rocky hillside, the wildflowers found a way to bloom. （读后续写·生命力·励志）
A classroom that welcomes questions becomes fertile soil for curiosity and original thought. （议论文·教育）
For fifty years the old farmer had tilled the same soil, and it knew his footsteps as well as he knew its every furrow. （读后续写·坚守·土地）
Reckless deforestation triggered severe soil erosion, and within a decade the once-green slopes had turned to dust. （议论文/应用文·环保）
Rotating crops each season is a time-honoured way to enrich the soil naturally. （应用文·科普/建议）
New ideas, like seeds, must take root in the soil of practice before they can bear fruit. （议论文·实践）
The gardener explained that these succulents thrive in dry, sandy soil rather than heavy clay. （应用文·说明）

synonyms.example: She scooped a handful of damp earth and gently pressed the seedling into place. （读后续写·种植·细节）
synonyms.usage: 更口语、更泛指地上的泥土；soil 更偏农学/科学语境，强调可供植物生长、含养分的土层

synonyms.example: The refugees longed for a piece of land they could finally call their own. （读后续写·家园）
synonyms.usage: 指大片地域、地产或国土，范围大而抽象；soil 指具体的、可耕种的泥土表层，或诗意的"故土"

synonyms.example: He knelt on the frozen ground, too exhausted to take another step. （读后续写·跋涉）
synonyms.usage: 指脚下的地面、地表，强调位置；soil 强调土壤的成分、肥力与生长功能

advancedExpressions.expression: the soil of ... had shaped who he was
advancedExpressions.example: Only now did he understand that the humble soil of his childhood home had quietly shaped who he was — every grain of it woven into the fabric of his soul. （only 引导倒装 + 隐喻 woven into the fabric，游子/寻根主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us return to the soil the care it has long given us
advancedExpressions.example: Let us return to the soil the care it has long given us, for a land nourished with love will nourish generations yet to come. （倡议句 let us + 双向 give/return 呼应，环保倡议）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... can only flourish when planted in the right soil
advancedExpressions.example: Talent, however dazzling, can only flourish when planted in the soil of discipline and opportunity; without them, even the finest seed withers unseen. （比喻论证 + 分号对照句，人才培养）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The soil was dry and no plants grew.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The soil lay cracked and lifeless beneath a merciless sun, split into a thousand pale scales like the skin of some ancient, dying beast, and not a single blade of green dared to break its silence. （读后续写·荒芜·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟物比喻 like the skin of...beast + split into...分词后置定语 + not a single...dared 拟人化否定强调荒凉

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect the soil.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we recognised that protecting the soil beneath our feet is no mere matter of agriculture, but the very foundation upon which our food, our forests and our future all quietly depend. （议论文·环保·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time we did... 虚拟语气 + no mere...but the very... 递进否定 + our...our...our 三重排比强化重要性

original_sentence: As the largest rainforest in the world, it plays a significant role in maintaining the fine balance of the Earth's ecosystem.
readingExamples: As the largest rainforest in the world, it plays a significant role in maintaining the fine balance of the Earth's ecosystem.
definitionEn:
(1) n. all the living things in an area and the way they affect each other and the environment
(2) n. a system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical surroundings
(3) n. (figurative) a complex network or interconnected system (e.g. a business or digital ecosystem)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （商业/数字领域比喻）生态圈，相互依存的系统
uncommonMeanings.example: The tiny bookshop was, in its own way, an ecosystem: the elderly owner, the regular readers, the stray cat by the window — remove any one, and the fragile magic would collapse. （读后续写·社区·相互依存的比喻）

posExamples.sentence: Wading into the shallow tidal pool, the children discovered a whole ecosystem in miniature — darting shrimp, waving anemones and crabs scuttling for cover the instant a shadow fell across the water. （读后续写·探索·自然发现）
I am writing to urge our school to build a small wetland garden, which would serve as a living ecosystem where students can observe nature's delicate balance first-hand. （应用文·建议信）
The reckless introduction of a single foreign species can throw an entire ecosystem into chaos, proving just how tightly every living thing is bound to the rest. （议论文·生态平衡）
Every drop of pollution we pour into the river ripples outward through the whole ecosystem, harming creatures we may never even see. （议论文/应用文·环保）

wordForms.other: ecology (n. 生态学) / ecological (adj. 生态的) / ecologically (adv.)

collocations.example: The coral reef is a fragile ecosystem that even the slightest rise in temperature can destroy. （议论文·气候变化）

collocations.phrase: maintain the balance of an ecosystem
collocations.example: Predators, far from being villains, quietly maintain the balance of the ecosystem by keeping prey populations in check. （议论文·生态）
Building a dam without proper study can disrupt the entire river ecosystem for decades. （议论文·环境影响）
The rainforest is home to the richest ecosystem on the planet, teeming with species science has yet to name. （读后续写/说明文·雨林）
Setting up nature reserves is one of the most effective ways to preserve threatened ecosystems. （应用文·倡议）
Volunteers spent three summers replanting native trees to restore the ecosystem the fire had destroyed. （读后续写·修复·希望）

collocations.translation: 海洋/森林/湿地生态系统
collocations.example: Wetland ecosystems act like the kidneys of the Earth, filtering pollutants from the water that flows through them. （说明文·科普）
As the largest rainforest on Earth, the Amazon plays a vital role in maintaining the balance of the global ecosystem. （议论文/说明文·雨林）

synonyms.example: We all share the responsibility of protecting the environment for future generations. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: 泛指周围的自然与外部条件，范围最广；ecosystem 强调生物与环境之间相互作用的"系统"，更专业、更强调关联性

synonyms.example: Deforestation is robbing countless animals of their natural habitat. （议论文·物种保护）
synonyms.usage: 指某物种生活的具体环境/家园；ecosystem 指整个群落与环境构成的更大整体，包含无数 habitat

synonyms.example: Human activity now affects nearly every corner of the biosphere. （议论文·全球生态）
synonyms.usage: 指地球上所有生命及其生存空间的总和，尺度最大、最宏观；ecosystem 是其中一个个相对独立的子系统

advancedExpressions.expression: she realised she too was part of something far greater — an ecosystem where every life mattered
advancedExpressions.example: Watching the bees drift from bloom to bloom, she realised she too was part of something far greater — an ecosystem where every life, however small, mattered. （破折号补充定义 + however small 让步插入，敬畏自然主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: only by protecting our ecosystems can we ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only by protecting the ecosystems on which we all depend can we hope to hand down a green and thriving planet to those who come after us. （only by...倒装强调 + on which 定语从句，倡议呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: an ecosystem is a web in which no thread can be pulled without ...
advancedExpressions.example: An ecosystem is a web in which no single thread can be pulled without setting the whole trembling; to harm one species is, in the end, to harm ourselves. （比喻定义 web + 分号哲理升华，生态整体性论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rainforest ecosystem is important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rainforest ecosystem is not merely important — it is the beating green heart of our planet, drawing in carbon, breathing out oxygen, and cradling half the living species on Earth within its endless canopy. （议论文/读后续写·雨林·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely...— it is... 破折号强调升华 + 隐喻 beating green heart + 三组现在分词并列 drawing/breathing/cradling

sentenceUpgrade.original: If we pollute the water, the ecosystem will be damaged.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Should we continue to poison our rivers, the intricate ecosystem they sustain will unravel thread by thread, and by the time we grasp the cost, it may already lie beyond all repair. （议论文·环保·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Should we...倒装虚拟条件句 + unravel thread by thread 延续"网"的比喻 + by the time...时间状语从句强化后果的不可逆

translation: adj. 海外的，国外的 | adv. 在海外，向国外
original_sentence: The Amazon rainforest crosses into eight countries, including Brazil and Peru, and one overseas region of France, all on the South American continent.
readingExamples: The Amazon rainforest crosses into eight countries, including Brazil and Peru, and one overseas region of France, all on the South American continent.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to, coming from, or happening in a foreign country, especially one across the sea
(2) adv. to or in a foreign country, especially one across the sea; abroad
(3) adj. involving travel or trade across the sea

posExamples.sentence: As the plane lifted off and China shrank to a scatter of lights below, Lin pressed her forehead to the cold window, torn between the thrill of studying overseas and the ache of leaving her ageing parents behind. （读后续写·留学·离别）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the overseas exchange programme, as his fluency and open-mindedness make him an ideal ambassador for our school abroad. （应用文·推荐信）
More and more young people now choose to study overseas, yet the true measure of such an experience lies not in the diploma earned but in the broadened mind brought home. （议论文·留学价值）
The charity's overseas volunteers spent their summer building classrooms in remote mountain villages, discovering that they received far more than they gave. （读后续写/应用文·志愿·成长）

collocations.example: When she finally saved enough to study overseas, her whole village turned out to see her off. （读后续写·梦想·送别）
Having worked overseas for a decade, he could speak four languages yet still dreamed in his mother tongue. （读后续写·游子）
Our university welcomes overseas students from more than sixty countries each year. （应用文·介绍/说明）
The small tea company gradually expanded into overseas markets, carrying a taste of home across the oceans. （说明文/议论文·商业）
Her first overseas trip opened her eyes to just how vast and varied the world truly was. （读后续写·成长）
The Amazon rainforest even stretches into one overseas region of France on the South American continent. （说明文·地理）
During the festival, overseas Chinese around the globe gather to share dumplings and stories of home. （说明文/读后续写·文化）
As the brand expanded overseas, it took care to respect the customs of every new market it entered. （议论文·全球化）

synonyms.example: He had always longed to travel abroad and see the world with his own eyes. （读后续写·梦想）
synonyms.usage: 只作副词，泛指"在/到国外"，不限于隔海；overseas 兼作形容词和副词，语义上更强调"跨越海洋"，也可作定语修饰名词

synonyms.example: Learning a foreign language is like being given a second pair of eyes. （议论文·语言）
synonyms.usage: 形容词，指"外国的、他国的"，可修饰各种名词；overseas 特指"海外的、跨海的"，且能作副词，foreign 不能

synonyms.example: The city hosted an international conference on climate change. （说明文·活动）
synonyms.usage: 强调"多国之间、国际性的"，涉及国与国关系；overseas 侧重"从本国到海外"的方向或来源，视角以本国为出发点

advancedExpressions.expression: no matter how far overseas life took her, ... remained her true north
advancedExpressions.example: No matter how far overseas life took her, the little courtyard where her grandmother once hummed old songs remained her true north, guiding her home across every ocean and every year. （no matter how 让步 + 隐喻 true north，思乡主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would strongly encourage every student to seize the chance to study overseas, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly encourage every student to seize the chance to study overseas, for stepping onto foreign soil is often the surest way to discover who we truly are. （建议句式 + for 引导原因，鼓励类应用文）

advancedExpressions.expression: studying overseas is not an escape from home but a journey back to it
advancedExpressions.example: Studying overseas is, paradoxically, not an escape from home but a journey back to it, for only by seeing the world through foreign eyes do we come to understand where we truly belong. （not...but 对照 + for only by...倒装，留学价值论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She went overseas to study and felt lonely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In her first winter overseas, loneliness wrapped around her like the grey city fog — endless, silent, seeping into every corner of the tiny rented room where no familiar voice ever called her name. （读后续写·孤独·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语前置 + 明喻 like the grey city fog + 三个形容词并列 endless/silent/seeping + where 定语从句渲染孤寂

sentenceUpgrade.original: Studying overseas has many benefits.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere pursuit of a foreign diploma, studying overseas broadens the mind, sharpens independence and, above all, teaches young people to see their own country with fresh and grateful eyes. （议论文·留学·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being... 否定前置强调 + 三动词并列 broadens/sharpens/teaches + above all 递进强调核心论点

original_sentence: The Amazon rainforest crosses into eight countries, including Brazil and Peru, and one overseas region of France, all on the South American continent.
readingExamples: The Amazon rainforest crosses into eight countries, including Brazil and Peru, and one overseas region of France, all on the South American continent.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large area of land, usually without exact borders, that is different from other areas in some way
(2) n. an administrative division of a country; an official district
(3) n. a particular part of the body or of an object
(4) n. (in the region of) an amount that is approximately a stated figure

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （in the region of）大约，接近（某数量）
uncommonMeanings.example: The restoration of the ancient temple was expected to cost somewhere in the region of two million yuan, a sum the small town could scarcely imagine raising. （应用文/读后续写·文物保护）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （身体或物体的）部位，区域
uncommonMeanings.example: A dull ache had settled in the region of his chest, and though he told himself it was only the cold, a quiet fear began to stir. （读后续写·健康·预感）

posExamples.sentence: As their jeep rattled deeper into the remote mountain region, the last signal bar vanished from their phones, and a thrilling, uneasy sense of true wilderness settled over the travellers. （读后续写·探险·环境）
I am writing to invite students from every region of the country to join our online cultural festival, where local customs and dialects can be proudly shared. （应用文·邀请信）
Economic development in coastal regions has far outpaced that of the inland areas, a widening gap that policymakers can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·区域发展）
The northern region is famous for its harsh winters, when snow blankets the endless plains and rivers freeze solid enough to walk across. （读后续写/说明文·地理）

collocations.example: Life in the desert region taught the nomads to treasure every single drop of water. （读后续写/说明文·生存）
The young doctor volunteered to serve in a remote region where no hospital had ever stood. （读后续写·奉献）
The festival is the most anticipated event in the region, drawing crowds from every neighbouring town. （说明文·活动）
News of the young hero's rescue spread rapidly throughout the region. （读后续写·英雄事迹）
Tibet is an autonomous region renowned for its breathtaking plateaus and rich culture. （说明文·地理/文化）
The charity concert raised in the region of fifty thousand yuan for the flood victims. （应用文·报告）
Bridging the digital divide between developed and developing regions remains a pressing global challenge. （议论文·公平）
Volunteers risked their lives to bring food and medicine to families in the war-torn region. （读后续写·人道·勇气）

synonyms.example: This area of the city is known for its lively night markets. （说明文·城市）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最口语，指任何大小的地方，无严格界定；region 通常指范围较大、有某种共同地理或行政特征的地区，更正式

synonyms.example: She grew up in a quiet residential district on the edge of town. （读后续写·背景）

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 倒装(Across ... drifted) + their ... 独立结构补充细节 + so ... that 结果状语 + 明喻(a painting)定格画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: The water lily grows in mud but is clean.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That the water lily should draw its very life from the mire, and yet unfurl a blossom of flawless white, is nature's quiet lesson that surroundings need not dictate one's essence. （议论文·正式书面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That从句作主语 + and yet 转折对比 + 抽象升华(nature's quiet lesson) + need not dictate 情态否定表达观点

translation: 不同种类；变化，多样性；变种，变体
original_sentence: The forest’s different levels support an unbelievable variety of wildlife.
readingExamples: The forest’s different levels support an unbelievable variety of wildlife.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the quality or state of having many different forms, types, or kinds; diversity
(2) n. a number of different things of the same general kind; an assortment
(3) n. a particular type or kind of something that differs from others of the same general class; a variant
(4) n. a type of plant or animal that belongs to a species but has distinct characteristics; a strain or cultivar

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物学）变种；栽培品种（属内的一个类别）
uncommonMeanings.example: After years of patient crossbreeding, the old farmer had developed a new variety of rice that could withstand both drought and flood — his life's quiet triumph. （读后续写·农人的毕生成就）

posExamples.sentence: As she wandered through the night market, a dazzling variety of smells, sounds and colours washed over her, and for the first time in months she felt utterly, wonderfully alive. （读后续写·感官描写）
To enrich campus life, I suggest that the school offer a greater variety of after-class activities, ranging from robotics workshops to traditional calligraphy classes. （应用文·建议信）
A healthy society, much like a thriving ecosystem, depends on variety: the wider the range of voices and talents it embraces, the more resilient and innovative it becomes. （议论文·多样性主题）

idioms.idiom: variety is the spice of life
idioms.translation: 多样化是生活的调味品（丰富多彩才是生活的乐趣）
idioms.example: "Variety is the spice of life," Grandpa always said, and it was he who taught me to try new paths rather than tread the same worn road every day. （读后续写·长辈的人生哲理）

collocations.phrase: a wide / great / rich variety of
collocations.translation: 多种多样的，五花八门的
collocations.example: The volunteer fair featured a wide variety of programmes, so that every student, whatever his talent, could find a cause worth serving. （应用文·活动报道）

collocations.phrase: a variety of reasons / ways / forms
collocations.translation: 各种各样的原因 / 方式 / 形式
collocations.example: People fail for a variety of reasons, but those who succeed almost always share one trait: they refuse to give up after the first defeat. （议论文·论成功）
To add variety to our weekly meetings, we decided to invite a different guest speaker each time. （应用文·社团计划）
For variety, she took the long way home that evening — a small choice that, unexpectedly, led her to an old friend she had not seen in years. （读后续写·偶然改变）
The whole family gathered around the television for the Spring Festival variety show, laughter filling the small warm room. （读后续写·节日团聚）

collocations.phrase: come in a variety of + 名词
collocations.translation: 有多种（款式 / 颜色等）
collocations.example: The handmade scarves came in a variety of colours, and the tourists could hardly decide which to buy. （读后续写·集市见闻）
Beneath the ocean's surface lies an almost infinite variety of life forms, many still unknown to science. （议论文·探索自然）

synonyms.example: The cultural diversity of our school — with students from a dozen provinces — enriches every classroom discussion. （议论文·文化多元）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、抽象，强调不同群体或元素并存的整体状态，常用于文化、生态、观点等议论文语境；variety 更口语化，也可指具体的种类集合

synonyms.example: She opened the tin to reveal an assortment of buttons, each one a fragment of some forgotten garment and story. （读后续写·旧物回忆）
synonyms.usage: 多指一堆混杂在一起的具体物品，偏口语，画面感强；variety 既可指具体集合，也可指抽象的多样性

synonyms.example: The scholarship is open to students across a wide range of disciplines, from the sciences to the fine arts. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 强调从一端到另一端的跨度或幅度，常与介词 of / from ... to ... 连用；variety 强调种类繁多而非跨度

advancedExpressions.expression: a dazzling / bewildering variety of ... greeted / met sb.
advancedExpressions.example: A dazzling variety of lanterns greeted them at the temple gate, and the children's eyes widened, drinking in every flickering colour. （用具体名词群铺陈画面，续写造境）

advancedExpressions.expression: offer / introduce a greater variety of ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely hope the canteen can introduce a greater variety of healthy dishes so that students with different needs are all well catered for. （建议信礼貌句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the greater the variety of ..., the more ...
advancedExpressions.example: The greater the variety of perspectives a team welcomes, the more likely it is to arrive at creative and lasting solutions. （the more ... the more 递进论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many different foods at the party.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The long table groaned under a bewildering variety of dishes — steaming dumplings, glazed pastries, bowls of crimson soup — and the aroma alone was enough to make the travellers' mouths water. （读后续写·宴席铺陈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a bewildering variety of替换many different + 破折号列举具体食物增强画面 + 拟人(the table groaned) + 结果句(enough to ...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should welcome different opinions.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely by embracing a variety of opinions — even those that grate against our own — that a community sharpens its judgement and guards itself against the perils of groupthink. （议论文·正式论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is ... that 强调句 + by embracing 动名词状语 + 破折号让步插入语 + 抽象化论证(sharpens its judgement, groupthink)

original_sentence: The forest’s different levels support an unbelievable variety of wildlife.
readingExamples: The forest’s different levels support an unbelievable variety of wildlife.
definitionEn:
(1) n. wild animals, birds, insects and other creatures that live in natural conditions, considered collectively
(2) n. all the undomesticated animals and plants of a region living in their natural environment
(3) n. (used attributively) relating to or concerned with wild animals and their protection, e.g. a wildlife reserve

posExamples.sentence: As the jeep rolled deeper into the savanna, wildlife appeared on every side — a herd of elephants trumpeting, a lone giraffe grazing — and the boy pressed his face to the window, hardly daring to breathe. （读后续写·野外探险）
I am writing to call on every student to join our campaign to protect local wildlife, for many species that once thrived in our wetlands are now on the brink of disappearing. （应用文·倡议书）

Protecting wildlife is not an act of charity toward animals but an investment in humanity's own survival, since the collapse of any single species can unravel the entire web of life on which we depend. （议论文·环保主题）

collocations.example: The young ranger had devoted twenty years to protecting wildlife, and the scars on his hands told stories no textbook ever could. （读后续写·人物刻画）

collocations.translation: 野生动物保护区 / 庇护所
collocations.example: The injured crane was carried to a nearby wildlife sanctuary, where gentle hands would nurse it back to flight. （读后续写·救助动物）
Her passion for wildlife conservation was born the day she watched a documentary about vanishing tigers. （读后续写·梦想缘起）

collocations.translation: 威胁 / 危害野生动物
collocations.example: Rampant deforestation not only strips the land bare but also endangers the countless species of wildlife that call the forest home. （议论文·生态破坏）
The wetland supports an astonishing diversity of wildlife, from tiny frogs to majestic migratory birds. （议论文·生物多样性）
Every hectare of forest cleared for farmland means one more wildlife habitat lost forever. （议论文·呼吁保护）
Kneeling silently in the tall grass for hours, the wildlife photographer finally captured the leopard's leap in a single, breathtaking frame. （读后续写·耐心与坚持）

synonyms.example: The remote island is home to a unique fauna found nowhere else on Earth. （议论文·生态独特性）
synonyms.usage: 学术、正式用词，专指某地区或某时期的全部动物（常与flora植物群对举）；wildlife 更通用，泛指野生动植物且更口语

synonyms.translation: 生物，动物（尤指非人类的）
synonyms.example: Every creature in the forest, however small, plays a part in the delicate balance of nature. （议论文·万物有其用）
synonyms.usage: 指单个具体的生物个体，可数；wildlife 是不可数集合名词，指野生动植物的总体

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·邂逅野生动物
advancedExpressions.expression: there, not ten metres away, stood / crouched a ...
advancedExpressions.example: There, not ten metres away, stood a magnificent stag, its antlers crowned with morning light, and the hikers froze, spellbound. （倒装+特写，续写高潮时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is high time that we ... to safeguard our wildlife
advancedExpressions.example: It is high time that we took concrete action — refusing products made from endangered species — to safeguard the wildlife with which we share this planet. （倡议信，虚拟语气增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: the loss of wildlife is not merely ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The loss of wildlife is not merely the disappearance of beautiful creatures, but a warning bell tolling for the health of the entire biosphere — and, ultimately, for ourselves. （not merely ... but 递进升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The forest has a lot of wildlife.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The forest teemed with wildlife: birdsong spilled from the canopy, unseen creatures rustled through the undergrowth, and every step seemed to stir some hidden life from its slumber. （读后续写·生机盎然）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: teemed with替换has a lot of + 冒号后三组并列画面(spilled, rustled, stir) + 拟人(stir ... from its slumber)营造生机

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must protect wildlife.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we hope to bequeath to our children a world still rich in birdsong and wonder, then protecting wildlife must cease to be a slogan and become a daily, deliberate choice. （议论文·呼吁行动）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If ... then 条件呼吁结构 + bequeath to our children 情感诉求 + cease to be ... and become 对比(口号 vs 行动)增强说服力

original_sentence: At the bottom, there is a system of roots beneath the ground.
readingExamples: At the bottom, there is a system of roots beneath the ground.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. in or to a lower position than something; directly under something
(2) prep. hidden below the surface of something, especially something that conceals the true nature underneath
(3) prep. lower in rank, status, or dignity than someone; unworthy of a person
(4) adv. (formal) in or to a lower place; underneath

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在身份、尊严上）配不上，有失……的身份
uncommonMeanings.example: She lifted her chin and turned away, making it clear that such a petty quarrel was utterly beneath her. （读后续写·人物尊严与气度）

posExamples.sentence: Beneath the calm, smiling face he showed the world, a storm of grief raged that no one, not even his closest friend, could ever guess. （读后续写·表里反差·心理描写）
During the earthquake drill, students are advised to take shelter beneath a sturdy desk and to remain there until the signal to evacuate is given. （应用文·安全须知）
Beneath every great achievement lies a foundation of unseen effort, and it is this hidden labour, rather than luck, that truly separates the accomplished from the ordinary. （议论文·努力与成就）

idioms.example: To betray the very friends who had saved him — such conduct was beneath contempt, and even his old allies now turned their backs on him. （读后续写·道德批判）
He considered it beneath his dignity to argue with a stranger in the street, and so he simply walked on, head held high. （读后续写·人物涵养）

collocations.translation: 在表面之下；隐藏在内心深处
collocations.example: On the surface she seemed cheerful, but beneath the surface lay a loneliness she had never confessed to anyone. （读后续写·内心刻画）
Buried beneath years of dust and forgotten memories, the old diary held the one secret that could change everything. （读后续写·发现秘密）
The little paper boat wobbled, tipped, and finally sank beneath the muddy water, taking the boy's wish down with it. （读后续写·童年失落）
When the news reached her, the ground beneath her feet seemed to give way, and she reached blindly for the wall. （读后续写·震惊时刻）
Beneath the ground, a vast network of roots quietly channels water and nourishment to every branch above. （议论文·根基的重要性）
Caught in the sudden downpour, the two strangers sheltered beneath the same shop awning and, to their surprise, struck up a lasting friendship. （读后续写·偶然相遇）

collocations.translation: 远在某人之下（地位、能力）
collocations.example: He never treated the cleaners as though they were far beneath him; on the contrary, he greeted each by name every morning. （读后续写·平等待人）

synonyms.example: The cat curled up under the warm blanket, purring softly as the rain drummed on the roof. （读后续写·温馨场景）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最口语，可指正下方或覆盖之下；beneath 更书面、更有文学色彩，且能表'配不上'的抽象义，under 不能

synonyms.example: From the mountaintop, the whole city sparkled far below, a scatter of lights against the dark. （读后续写·俯瞰视角）
synonyms.usage: 强调位置更低但不一定正下方或接触，常表高度/等级上的低；beneath 更强调正下方或被覆盖，且更正式

synonyms.example: Underneath the floorboards, they found a rusted tin box no one had touched for half a century. （读后续写·意外发现）
synonyms.usage: 口语与书面皆可，尤强调'紧贴下方、藏在底下'的具体位置；beneath 更文雅，且可用于抽象义

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath the ... exterior / surface lay / hid ...
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath the gruff, forbidding exterior lay a heart as soft and warm as freshly baked bread. （倒装+比喻，揭示人物真性情）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are advised to take shelter beneath ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the event of a fire drill, you are advised to stay low and move beneath the smoke toward the nearest exit. （通知/须知，客观指令句）

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath the appearance of ... lies the reality of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath the glittering appearance of instant success lies the sobering reality of years of unglamorous, unnoticed toil. （倒装揭示本质，表象与实质对照）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He hid his sadness under a smile.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath the easy smile he offered the world, a quiet sorrow stirred like a river running deep and dark under thinning ice — visible to no one, felt by him alone. （读后续写·心理+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beneath 引导倒装状语前置 + 明喻(river under thinning ice)具象化隐藏的悲伤 + 破折号补充+对比(no one / him alone)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Behind success there is a lot of hard work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath every triumph that dazzles the public eye lies a long, silent apprenticeship of failure, doubt and dogged persistence — the part of the story no applause ever reaches. （议论文·揭示本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beneath ... lies 倒装强调结构 + 三名词并列(failure, doubt, persistence) + 破折号收尾金句 + 抽象升华(apprenticeship)

translation: n. 大量；团，块，堆；一大群 | adj. 大批的，广泛的
original_sentence: Above that is the mass of leaf litter on the dark forest floor.
readingExamples: Above that is the mass of leaf litter on the dark forest floor.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large amount or quantity of something that has no definite shape; a body of matter with no distinct form
(2) n. a large number of people or things gathered or considered together; a crowd
(3) n. (physics) the amount of matter that an object contains, measured in kilograms
(4) adj. involving or affecting a large number of people or things; large-scale
(5) n. (the masses) the ordinary people of a society, as distinct from an elite

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物理）质量（物体所含物质的量）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the quiet lab, she recorded the mass of each sample to the milligram, unaware that these patient measurements would one day underpin a breakthrough. （读后续写·科研之路）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （Mass，大写）弥撒（天主教仪式）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every Sunday the old woman walked two miles to attend Mass, her worn prayer book pressed to her chest like a lifelong companion. （读后续写·信仰与坚守）

posExamples.sentence: As the fog lifted, a dark mass of storm clouds loomed on the horizon, and the fishermen exchanged uneasy glances before hurrying to pull in their nets. （读后续写·环境预兆·紧张氛围）
On the morning of the charity run, a mass of enthusiastic volunteers gathered at the school gate, their bright vests glowing in the early light. （应用文·活动报道）
Mass participation in recycling programmes, rather than the isolated efforts of a few, is what will ultimately determine whether our cities can reverse the tide of waste. （议论文·环保·集体行动）

idioms.example: True art, he argued, should not remain locked in galleries for the few but should reach the masses in the streets and the schools. （议论文·艺术普及）
The documentary warned that the greatest threat to peace was no longer any single weapon of mass destruction, but human indifference itself. （议论文·和平反思）

collocations.translation: 大量的，一大堆 / 一大群
collocations.example: Buried under a mass of unmarked papers, the young teacher worked past midnight, determined that not one student's effort would go unseen. （读后续写·敬业教师）
There were masses of people at the station that holiday morning, each dragging a suitcase heavy with gifts and homesickness. （读后续写·返乡人潮）
The mass media wield enormous power in shaping public opinion, and with that power comes a heavy responsibility for truth. （议论文·媒体责任）
Mass production made the goods cheap and plentiful, yet something of the craftsman's soul was lost along the way. （议论文·工业化反思）
Once a hidden gem, the fishing village was nearly swallowed by mass tourism, its quiet charm trampled by the very crowds that came to admire it. （议论文·旅游影响）

collocations.translation: 群众运动 / 大规模抗议
collocations.example: What began as a handful of students handing out leaflets swelled, within weeks, into a mass movement for cleaner air. （读后续写·由小到大）
Scientists warn that we may be witnessing a sixth mass extinction, this time driven not by asteroids but by human hands. （议论文·生态危机）
While a few voices dominate the headlines, the great mass of ordinary citizens quietly keep society running day after day. （议论文·平凡的力量）

synonyms.example: A heap of fallen leaves lay in the corner of the yard, and the children dived into it, shrieking with delight. （读后续写·童趣画面）
synonyms.usage: 多指杂乱无章、堆叠起来的具体一堆东西，画面感强；mass 既可指具体大量，也可指抽象群体或物理质量，范围更广

synonyms.example: The crowd surged forward as the gates opened, and she clung to her little brother's hand so as not to lose him. （读后续写·拥挤人潮）
synonyms.usage: 专指聚集的人群，可数；a mass of people 与 crowd 义近，但 mass 更强调数量之多、连成一片、难分个体

synonyms.example: The bulk of the harvest was stored away for winter, leaving only a little to sell at the market. （读后续写·农家储粮）
synonyms.usage: the bulk of 指某物的'大部分/主体'，也指庞大体积；mass 强调无定形的大量或群体，二者搭配与语境不同

advancedExpressions.expression: a mass of ... loomed / gathered / rose ...
advancedExpressions.example: A mass of grey clouds gathered overhead, swallowing the last of the sunlight, and an uneasy hush settled over the valley. （用无定形的'一片'渲染压抑氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: we call for the mass participation of ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely call for the mass participation of every class in this tree-planting campaign, for only together can we turn our bare hillside green. （倡议信，强调全员参与）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not ... but the collective effort of the masses that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the brilliance of a single leader but the collective effort of the masses that ultimately propels a nation forward. （强调句+集体力量论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many clouds in the sky.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A great mass of clouds rolled in from the west, blotting out the sun and dragging a premature dusk across the fields, as if nature itself were holding its breath. （读后续写·环境预兆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A great mass of替换many + 动词链(rolled, blotting, dragging)推进画面 + as if 拟人比喻营造紧张预感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people joining in is important for change.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History has shown, time and again, that lasting change is seldom the gift of a solitary hero; rather, it is forged in the mass participation of countless ordinary people, each contributing a spark that, together, becomes a blaze. （议论文·集体力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: History has shown ... 权威开篇 + 分号对比(not hero; rather masses) + 比喻(spark ... blaze)升华 + each contributing 独立结构补充

original_sentence: Then there are the towering ancient hardwoods, and finally the tops of the tallest trees many metres above the ground.
readingExamples: Then there are the towering ancient hardwoods, and finally the tops of the tallest trees many metres above the ground.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. extremely tall or high, so as to seem to rise far above everything around
(2) adj. (of a person or achievement) outstanding and of great importance; far superior to others
(3) adj. (of an emotion, especially anger) very great and intense

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （怒火、情绪）极其强烈的
uncommonMeanings.example: He stormed out in a towering rage, slamming the door so hard that the windows rattled and the whole house seemed to flinch. （读后续写·冲突爆发·情绪失控）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 杰出的，出类拔萃的（成就、人物）
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after his death, he remained a towering figure in Chinese literature, his words still lighting the way for generations of young readers. （读后续写·缅怀致敬）

posExamples.sentence: As we emerged from the narrow trail, a towering waterfall thundered down the cliff, its spray drifting toward us like a cool, silver veil that left us utterly speechless. （读后续写·自然探险·震撼场景）
I am writing to recommend our city's Central Museum, whose towering marble columns and vast collections will surely leave every foreign visitor with an unforgettable impression. （应用文·推荐信）
In an age obsessed with instant fame, we should remember that a truly towering achievement is built not overnight, but through years of quiet, unglamorous persistence. （议论文·成功与坚持）
The little girl gazed up at the towering ancient oak, its gnarled branches spreading like protective arms above her, and felt, for the first time, wonderfully small. （读后续写·童年·敬畏自然）

collocations.example: Beyond the village stood a towering mountain, its snow-capped peak vanishing into the morning mist. （读后续写·环境描写）
As a towering figure in medical research, she inspired thousands of young scientists to devote themselves to curing rare diseases. （应用文·人物介绍）
The completion of the bridge was a towering achievement that finally connected two long-isolated communities. （议论文·工程与进步）
In a towering fury, he tore the letter to shreds and flung the pieces into the fire. （读后续写·愤怒爆发）
The new skyscraper towers over every other building in the district, dominating the skyline for miles around. （读后续写·城市景象）
Driven by a towering ambition, the young inventor refused to abandon his dream despite one failure after another. （读后续写·励志）
The tiny boat was tossed helplessly among towering waves that rose like moving walls of black water. （读后续写·海上遇险）

synonyms.example: From the lofty peak, the climbers looked down upon a sea of clouds glowing golden in the dawn light. （读后续写·登顶）
synonyms.usage: 书面色彩更浓，既可指物理上的高，也可指理想/目标的崇高；towering 更强调压倒性的高大与气势

synonyms.translation: 壮观的，令人肃然起敬的

original_sentence: When a jaguar dies, a tiny army of microorganisms helps break down its body and return the nutrients to the earth.

synonyms.example: The warm bowl of porridge offered not merely nourishment but comfort, a small anchor of home in a cold and unfamiliar city. （读后续写·温情·双关）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Human activities affect the planet a lot.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is no denying that... 强调句 + exert an impact 正式搭配 + 现在分词状语揭示后果(pushing...to the brink)

original_sentence: As the impact of human activities continues to grow and the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer, we are left with a question: can we afford to damage the “lungs of the planet”?
readingExamples: As the impact of human activities continues to grow and the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer, we are left with a question: can we afford to damage the “lungs of the planet”?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a situation in which a plant, animal, or other species no longer exists
(2) n. the process of dying out completely so that none of its kind remain
(3) n. the act of putting an end to something, such as a hope, feeling, or fire (formal)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （希望、情感、火焰等的）熄灭，消亡（书面）
uncommonMeanings.example: With his last hope of rescue gone, something inside him died too — the slow extinction of a fire that had kept him walking for seven long days. （读后续写·绝境·心理隐喻）

posExamples.sentence: Standing before the empty glass case in the museum, the little girl asked why the dodo was gone, and her father struggled to explain that extinction means goodbye forever. （读后续写·亲子·情感冲击）
I am writing to appeal for your urgent support, for without immediate action, several rare species in our local wetland face the very real threat of extinction. （应用文·呼吁信）
The mass extinction of species now unfolding is not some distant tragedy; it is a mirror in which humanity may glimpse its own uncertain future. （议论文·生态危机）
As the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer year by year, we are forced to confront an uncomfortable question about our own place in nature. （议论文·物种保护）

collocations.phrase: on the brink / verge of extinction
collocations.example: Once numbering in the millions, the passenger pigeon was driven to the brink of extinction within a single human lifetime. （议论文·物种）
Unless their forest home is protected, these gentle giants will face extinction before the century is out. （应用文·呼吁）
Conservationists work tirelessly to lift the giant panda out from under the threat of extinction. （议论文·保护）

collocations.translation: 大灭绝，物种大规模灭绝
collocations.example: Scientists warn that the earth may be entering its sixth mass extinction, this time at human hands. （议论文·环境）
Reckless hunting and shrinking habitats have together driven many noble creatures to extinction. （议论文·因果）
A dedicated breeding programme finally saved the last of the wild horses from extinction. （读后续写·希望）
The tiny golden frog, found only on this single mountain, is now seriously in danger of extinction. （说明文·物种）
The current rate of extinction is estimated to be hundreds of times faster than the natural background rate. （议论文·数据）

synonyms.example: The disappearance of bees from our gardens would spell disaster for the crops we depend on. （议论文·生态链）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'消失、不见'，可暂时也可永久，语气较中性；extinction 特指物种'永久性灭绝'，不可逆

synonyms.example: Many indigenous languages are quietly dying out as the elders who speak them pass away. （议论文·文化）
synonyms.usage: 动词短语 die out 的名词化，较口语；可指物种、语言、习俗等的消亡，extinction 更正式、更常用于物种

synonyms.example: The asteroid strike brought about the near-total annihilation of life on the planet. （议论文·灾难/科普）
synonyms.usage: 语气极强，强调'被彻底摧毁、抹去'，常带外力施加的暴力感；extinction 侧重物种'不复存在'这一结果状态

advancedExpressions.expression: to save ... from extinction is, in truth, to save ...
advancedExpressions.example: To save these vanishing creatures from extinction is, in truth, to save a part of ourselves — the wonder, the wildness, the humility that first made us human. （破折号定义+排比意象，续写主旨升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we can no longer stand by while ... slides towards extinction
advancedExpressions.example: We can no longer stand by while species after species slides towards extinction; the time for action is not tomorrow, but today. （stand by 冷眼旁观+对比呼吁，呼吁信高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: the extinction of a single species is never ... ; it ...
advancedExpressions.example: The extinction of a single species is never an isolated loss; it is a torn thread in a web so vast and intricate that its full unravelling may reach us before we even notice. （否定递进+比喻(web/thread)，凸显系统性后果）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many animals are dying out because of humans.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Driven from their shrinking habitats and hunted for profit, countless animals are being pushed silently towards extinction, their disappearance a quiet indictment of human greed. （议论文·观点句+情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词开头状语(Driven...hunted) + be pushed towards 被动强调无辜 + 名词同位语作评论(a quiet indictment)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bird was gone forever and she felt sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the last of the songbirds fell silent, she understood at last what extinction truly meant — not a word in a textbook, but an emptiness where a whole chorus of life had once sung. （读后续写·情感深化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when 时间状语引出转折 + at last 顿悟 + 破折号对比(word vs. emptiness) + 拟人意象(chorus of life sung)

original_sentence: As the impact of human activities continues to grow and the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer, we are left with a question: can we afford to damage the “lungs of the planet”?
readingExamples: As the impact of human activities continues to grow and the list of species in danger of extinction becomes longer, we are left with a question: can we afford to damage the “lungs of the planet”?
definitionEn:
(1) v. to harm or spoil something physically so that it is broken, less useful, or less attractive
(2) v. to have a harmful effect on someone's reputation, health, feelings, or chances of success
(3) n. physical harm caused to something so that it is broken or spoiled
(4) n. (damages, plural) money paid by law as compensation for harm or loss

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （damages 复数）损害赔偿金（法律用语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The court ordered the polluting factory to pay heavy damages to the villagers whose water it had poisoned for years. （议论文·法律/环境）

posExamples.sentence: One careless spark from the campfire was enough to damage the ancient woodland that had stood, green and whispering, for a thousand years. （读后续写·环境·痛惜）
When the storm finally passed, the villagers walked out into the grey dawn to survey the damage — roofs torn away, orchards flattened, yet somehow their spirits unbroken. （读后续写·灾后·画面感）
I am writing to warn fellow students that spreading unverified rumours online can seriously damage a classmate's reputation and cause wounds that words alone cannot heal. （应用文·倡议信）
Can we really afford to damage the 'lungs of the planet' for short-term profit, when the harm we do today may prove impossible to undo tomorrow? （议论文·环保反问）

idioms.translation: 木已成舟，损害已经造成（无法挽回）
idioms.example: By the time the company apologised, the damage was done, and public trust had drained away like water through cupped hands. （议论文·信任危机）

collocations.example: Years of overfishing have done irreparable damage to the once-teeming coral reefs. （议论文·海洋）
The earthquake caused severe damage to the old town, yet not a single life was lost thanks to the timely warning. （读后续写·灾难）
The pipeline project was finally abandoned once the scale of the potential environmental damage became clear. （议论文·环保）
It may take decades of patient effort to repair the damage that a few reckless years inflicted on the forest. （议论文·恢复）
A single dishonest act can damage a lifetime's reputation beyond repair. （议论文·诚信）
The floodwaters left the family's photographs damaged beyond repair, washing away memories no money could replace. （读后续写·失去）
Prolonged stress can do lasting damage to both body and mind if left unchecked. （说明文·健康）
As the scandal spread, the manager scrambled into damage control, but the truth had already outrun every excuse. （议论文·危机）
In the rush to modernise, traditional crafts became the quiet collateral damage of progress. （议论文·发展代价）

synonyms.example: The gentle giant would not harm a fly, for all its fearsome size. （读后续写·反差）
synonyms.usage: 泛指对健康、安全、利益的伤害，可具体可抽象，语气较通用；damage 更强调对具体事物结构/功能/价值的破坏

synonyms.example: One thoughtless comment threatened to ruin the friendship they had spent years building. （读后续写·人际）
synonyms.usage: 语气最重，指'彻底毁掉、化为乌有'，结果不可逆；damage 程度可轻可重，常可修复

synonyms.translation: 损坏，糟蹋，破坏（兴致/美感）
synonyms.example: A sudden downpour spoiled the picnic we had looked forward to all week. （记叙·扫兴）
synonyms.usage: 多指破坏美好、乐趣、味道或效果，日常口语常用；damage 更中性、更常指实质性物理/名誉损害

advancedExpressions.expression: the damage, though visible everywhere, could not ...
advancedExpressions.example: The damage, though visible in every fallen beam and shattered window, could not reach the one thing that mattered most — the unshakeable bond that held the family together. （让步插入语+though 转折，续写由灾难转向温情）

advancedExpressions.expression: before the damage becomes irreversible, let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before the damage we inflict on our rivers becomes irreversible, let us act together — refusing plastic, planting trees, and speaking up for the voiceless. （before 紧迫+let us 号召+三动词排比，倡议信结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: the damage done to ... far outlasts ...
advancedExpressions.example: The damage done to a fragile ecosystem far outlasts the fleeting profit that caused it; nature keeps a long and unforgiving memory. （far outlast 对比+拟人化警示，凸显后果的长期性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The flood damaged many houses.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The raging flood swept through the valley overnight, leaving in its wake row upon row of houses damaged beyond recognition, their doors gaping open onto ruined homes. （读后续写·灾难描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: raging 修饰增强 + leave in one's wake 固定表达 + row upon row 叠词强调规模 + 独立主格补充画面(doors gaping)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not damage the environment for money.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be the height of folly to inflict lasting damage upon the environment merely for the sake of short-lived profit. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be the height of folly to... 强烈评价句式 + inflict damage upon 正式搭配 + merely for the sake of 贬抑动机

original_sentence: For another thing, due to the Amazon’s hot climate, it is difficult for the soil to build up enough nutrients.
readingExamples: For another thing, due to the Amazon’s hot climate, it is difficult for the soil to build up enough nutrients.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the general weather conditions typical of a particular region over a long period
(2) n. the general attitude, mood, or set of conditions prevailing in a place, organisation, or period (e.g. political climate)
(3) n. an area or region considered with reference to its typical weather

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （社会、政治、经济等的）氛围，风气，形势
uncommonMeanings.example: In the tense political climate of those years, a single careless remark could cost a person everything, so most people learned to weigh each word before speaking. （读后续写/议论文·时代氛围）

posExamples.sentence: Stepping off the plane into the sticky tropical climate, she felt the heat wrap around her like a damp blanket, and knew at once that this journey would change her forever. （读后续写·异国·感官描写）
I am writing to invite you to our school forum on climate change, where students will share simple yet powerful ways to protect the only planet we call home. （应用文·邀请信）
Tackling climate change is not the duty of governments alone; it demands the small, daily choices of every ordinary citizen who dares to care. （议论文·环保责任）
Due to the Amazon's hot and humid climate, the soil struggles to build up nutrients, making the rainforest far more fragile than its lush appearance suggests. （议论文·自然科普）

collocations.example: Rising sea levels are among the most alarming signs that climate change is no longer a distant threat but a present reality. （议论文·环境）

collocations.translation: 全球变暖 / 变暖的气候
collocations.example: A warming climate is quietly redrawing the map of where crops can grow and where deserts will spread. （议论文·农业）

collocations.translation: 热带 / 温带 / 干旱气候
collocations.example: The date palm thrives in a dry climate that would kill most other fruit trees. （说明文·植物）
Despite the harsh climate of the plateau, the herders had learned to live in quiet harmony with the land. （读后续写·适应）
It took the settlers years to adapt to the freezing climate of their new mountain home. （读后续写·移居）
Young people around the world are demanding that leaders treat the climate crisis with the urgency it truly deserves. （议论文·呼吁）
In the current economic climate, many graduates are choosing security over ambition when they hunt for jobs. （议论文·社会）
A good leader nurtures a climate of trust in which every member feels free to speak the truth. （议论文·领导力）

synonyms.example: The weather turned suddenly, and dark clouds swallowed the sun that had shone all morning. （读后续写·转折）
synonyms.usage: 指某时某地短期的天气状况（今天、此刻）；climate 指某地区长期、总体的气候规律

synonyms.example: A warm, welcoming atmosphere filled the little café the moment the fire was lit. （读后续写·场景）
synonyms.usage: 对应 climate 的'氛围'义，指某场合当下的感觉/情调；climate（氛围义）更偏长期、大范围的社会风气

synonyms.example: The rescue was called off because the conditions on the mountain had become too dangerous. （记叙·处境）
synonyms.usage: 泛指各种客观情况（天气、经济、工作等），需搭配语境；climate 特指气候或长期整体氛围

advancedExpressions.expression: the harsh climate ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: The harsh climate of the far north would break most spirits within a season, yet in this frozen wilderness the boy discovered a strength he had never known he had. （yet 转折+环境衬托人物，续写设景）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the face of a changing climate, it falls to each of us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the face of a rapidly changing climate, it falls to each of us to rethink how we travel, what we buy, and how much we waste. （in the face of 面对+it falls to sb. to 责任落实，倡议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: climate change is not a matter of ... but of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Climate change is not a matter of if, but of when and how severely; to delay action any longer is to gamble recklessly with our children's future. （not...but 强调+gamble with 比喻警示，凸显紧迫）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The climate there was very hot and she felt uncomfortable.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The sweltering climate pressed down on her like an invisible weight, drawing beads of sweat from her brow and sapping the strength from her legs with every dragging step. （读后续写·感官描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: sweltering 精准形容词 + press down like 明喻 + 现在分词并列(drawing...sapping) + 细节动作(beads of sweat / dragging step)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone should do something about climate change.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that each of us shouldered our share of responsibility in the fight against climate change, for the planet cannot wait for someone else to act first. （议论文·呼吁句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 虚拟语气(shouldered) 表紧迫 + shoulder one's share of responsibility 正式搭配 + for 引出理由从句

original_sentence: For another thing, due to the Amazon’s hot climate, it is difficult for the soil to build up enough nutrients.
readingExamples: For another thing, due to the Amazon’s hot climate, it is difficult for the soil to build up enough nutrients.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to increase or develop gradually over a period of time, or to make something do this
(2) v. to gradually create or accumulate something (a reputation, strength, a collection) through effort
(3) v. to give someone more confidence or make something seem more important, often through praise or publicity
(4) v. to cover an area of land with buildings

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 过分吹捧;为……大肆造势(常带贬义)
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole village had built the newcomer up as some kind of hero, so when he turned out to be an ordinary, awkward man, the disappointment was almost cruel. （读后续写·期望落空·反差）

posExamples.sentence: As the fever refused to break, a knot of dread began to build up in her chest, tightening with every shallow breath her little brother took beneath the thin blanket. （读后续写·危机·心理描写）
I am writing to suggest that we build up a small library of donated books in the classroom, so that every student, regardless of family background, can enjoy the quiet pleasure of reading. （应用文·建议信）
Genuine confidence is not handed to us overnight; rather, it is built up slowly, through countless small victories over the fears that once seemed insurmountable. （议论文·成长与自信）
Over the years, the old craftsman had built up a reputation for honesty that no amount of advertising could ever have bought. （读后续写·人物·口碑）

wordForms.adjective: built-up (adj. 建筑密集的;逐渐形成的)

collocations.example: The coach urged us to build up our stamina gradually, warning that shortcuts would only end in injury. （读后续写·体育训练）
A single word of encouragement from her mentor did more to build up her confidence than a year of private tutoring. （读后续写·师生鼓励）
It takes decades to build up a good reputation, yet a single careless act can tear it down in a moment. （议论文·诚信主题）
Over the summer he built up a collection of pressed leaves, each one labelled with the date and place he had found it. （读后续写·爱好·细节）
Regular exercise helps the body build up immunity against common illnesses. （应用文·健康倡议）
As the deadline approached, the tension in the office continued to build up until no one dared to speak above a whisper. （读后续写·氛围渲染）
By setting aside a little each month, the young couple slowly built up enough savings to open their own bookshop. （读后续写·奋斗·励志）
The music built up to a thunderous climax, and the entire hall rose to its feet as one. （读后续写·演出·高潮）

synonyms.example: Snow accumulated on the windowsill hour after hour, until the whole street lay hushed beneath a blanket of white. （读后续写·环境描写）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更书面,强调数量一点点增多的结果;build up 更口语,可指抽象的信心、名声,也可指物质的堆积

synonyms.example: Through years of patient practice, she developed a steady hand and a keen eye that few surgeons could match. （议论文·能力养成）
synonyms.usage: 强调从无到有、由弱变强的整体成长过程;build up 更突出"逐步增加"这一渐进动作本身

synonyms.example: Frequent letters strengthened the bond between the two old friends despite the ocean that lay between them. （应用文·友谊）
synonyms.usage: 强调使已有的东西变得更牢固;build up 可从零开始逐步搭建,strengthen 通常针对既有基础

advancedExpressions.expression: little by little, a ... began to build up within sb.
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little, a quiet determination began to build up within him, until at last he squared his shoulders and stepped into the storm. （渐进副词+抽象名词具象化,续写蓄势段）

advancedExpressions.expression: by doing ..., we can gradually build up ...
advancedExpressions.example: By recycling just one bottle a day, we can gradually build up a cleaner, greener campus for every generation to come. （从小事切入的号召句式，倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: what takes years to build up can be destroyed in ...
advancedExpressions.example: What takes years of honest effort to build up can be destroyed in a single reckless moment — this is why integrity must never be treated as negotiable. （对比+因果，诚信类论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She slowly got her confidence back.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Bit by bit, like a tide creeping back over sun-baked sand, her confidence built up again, until the girl who had once trembled before the class now met every gaze without flinching. （读后续写·心理转变+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: bit by bit渐进节奏 + like a tide...明喻 + until引导结果状语呈现前后反差 + who once...定语从句强化对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect our school's good name.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is incumbent upon each of us to safeguard the fine reputation our school has built up over the decades, for such trust, once broken, can rarely be mended. （议论文·正式论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb. to do正式责任句式 + built up over the decades现在完成时强调积累 + for引导原因 + once broken过去分词短语作条件

original_sentence: Global warming, for example, is a major problem caused by greenhouse gases.
readingExamples: Global warming, for example, is a major problem caused by greenhouse gases.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. affecting or including the whole world
(2) adj. considering or including all parts of something; general or overall
(3) adj. (computing) applying to or affecting the whole of a file, program or system rather than one part of it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 全局的,整体考虑的;总体的
uncommonMeanings.example: Instead of fussing over a single misplaced comma, the editor urged her to take a more global view of the essay and ask whether the argument as a whole held together. （读后续写/议论文·整体思维）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the summit at dawn, she watched the sunlight spill across ridge after ridge and suddenly grasped how small her worries were against the vast, breathing body of the global wilderness. （读后续写·壮景·感悟）
I am writing to invite you to our school's Global Culture Festival, where students from over twenty countries will share the food, music and stories of their homelands. （应用文·邀请函）
Climate change is not a problem that any single nation can solve alone; only through global cooperation and a shared sense of responsibility can humanity hope to safeguard the planet. （议论文·环保·国际合作）

collocations.example: Global warming has caused glaciers that stood for thousands of years to melt away within a single lifetime. （议论文·环境）
A crisis in one corner of the world can now send shockwaves through the entire global economy within hours. （议论文·经济全球化）
Plastic pollution has reached alarming levels on a global scale, threatening marine life from the Arctic to the tropics. （议论文·环保）
The internet has turned our vast planet into a global village, where a message can cross oceans in the blink of an eye. （议论文·科技与交流）
Learning a foreign language is the first step toward becoming a true global citizen who respects and embraces other cultures. （应用文·演讲稿）
Studying abroad gave her a global perspective that reshaped the way she saw both the world and her own hometown. （读后续写·成长）
Thanks to e-commerce, even a small family workshop can now reach customers in the global market. （议论文·商业）
A single scientific breakthrough in medicine can have a global impact, saving countless lives across every continent. （议论文·科技）

synonyms.example: The charity concert was broadcast to a worldwide audience of nearly two billion viewers. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 多作形容词或副词,强调"覆盖全世界各地"这一地理范围;global 除地理范围外还可指"整体的、全局的",含义更广

synonyms.example: The young diplomat devoted her life to promoting peace through international cooperation. （议论文·国际关系）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"跨越国界、多国之间"的关系与往来;global 强调"作为一个整体的全世界",不聚焦国与国的界限

synonyms.example: The longing for home is a universal feeling, understood by every human heart regardless of language or nation. （读后续写·情感升华）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"对所有人普遍适用、放之四海皆准";global 强调地理或整体上的"全世界"，未必涉及"人人共通"之意

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment, sb. saw ... on a global scale
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment, gazing down from the plane, she saw for the first time how borders faded and how, on a global scale, all human struggles were somehow one and the same. （视角拉远+抽象升华，续写结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: as global citizens, we bear the responsibility to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As global citizens, we bear the responsibility to protect this fragile planet we all call home, starting with the smallest actions in our daily lives. （身份定位+责任呼吁，演讲稿/倡议书）

advancedExpressions.expression: only through global cooperation can ...

synonyms.example: The thick city walls offered little protection against a foe armed with cannons. （读后续写·历史场景）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect our environment.

translation: 各种不同的，各种各样的

definitionEn:
(1) adj. several different; of many different kinds

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke over the market, various vendors began to appear from every alley, their carts laden with fruit, flowers and warm, fragrant bread. （读后续写·清晨集市·画面铺陈）

collocations.example: The government has taken various measures to curb air pollution in industrial cities. （议论文·环境治理）
The exhibition displayed various kinds of folk art, each telling a story of a vanishing way of life. （读后续写·文化展览）
For various reasons, many young people are reluctant to return to their hometowns after graduation. （议论文·城乡问题）

A responsible researcher gathers evidence from various sources before drawing any conclusion. （议论文·治学态度）
The community hall is used for various purposes, from wedding banquets to charity sales. （应用文·场所介绍）

synonyms.example: Our school prides itself on a diverse student body drawn from more than twenty countries. （应用文·学校介绍）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：diverse 强调彼此差异明显、构成多元，常带积极的"丰富多彩"色彩，多修饰群体、文化、观点；various 更中性，只强调"数量多且种类不一"。

synonyms.example: Numerous studies have confirmed that reading widens one's horizons. （议论文·引证）

synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：assorted 多用于具体的、混装在一起的物品（糖果、饼干等），口语色彩浓；various 使用范围更广，抽象具体皆可，更书面。

advancedExpressions.expression: various ... began to emerge / appear, each ...

advancedExpressions.expression: we have taken various measures, ranging from ... to ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The company uses different methods to cut pollution.

translation: n. 过程，进程，步骤 | vt. 处理，加工
original_sentence: We’ve been taking various measures, including the use of new technologies, to reduce pollution in the production process, even though these measures raise our production costs.
readingExamples: We’ve been taking various measures, including the use of new technologies, to reduce pollution in the production process, even though these measures raise our production costs.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a series of actions or events that produce a particular result or change gradually
(2) n. a series of things you do to achieve a particular result; a method of doing or making something
(3) vt. to deal with an official document, request or information in the usual routine way
(4) vt. to treat raw material, food, etc. in order to change it, preserve it or prepare it for use

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对信息、经历）在头脑中消化、理解、接受
uncommonMeanings.example: She sat by the window long after the letter fell from her hands, unable to process the news that the person she loved most was gone. （读后续写·丧失之痛·心理消化）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用机器或化学方法）加工、处理（原料、食品、胶卷等）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old plant that once processed sugar cane now stood silent, its rusted machinery a monument to a booming past. （读后续写·工业遗迹·今昔对比）

posExamples.sentence: Recovery, she came to understand, was not a single leap but a slow, uneven process — two steps forward, one step back, yet somehow always inching toward the light. （读后续写·成长疗愈·过程感悟）

collocations.translation: 一个渐进 / 缓慢的过程

collocations.phrase: speed up / slow down the process

synonyms.example: Please follow the correct procedure when applying for a library card. （应用文·说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：procedure 强调按固定顺序进行的一套正式"步骤 / 手续"，偏静态、可复制；process 强调事物由始至终发展、变化的动态"过程"，可长可短。

synonyms.example: No one could predict the outcome of the fierce debate until the very last vote was counted. （议论文·不确定性）
synonyms.usage: 指整个过程最终的结果或结局,中性,常用于比赛、谈判、事件;consequence 强调因果链中'由某行为引出'的后续影响

synonyms.example: In the aftermath of the flood, neighbours who had never spoken now worked side by side to rebuild. （读后续写·灾后重建）
synonyms.usage: 特指灾难、战争、事故之后的一段时期及其影响,画面感强、色彩沉重;consequence 更抽象、适用面更广

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp the consequence of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did I grasp the full consequence of my silence — that a single word, had I dared to speak it, might have changed everything. （倒装+虚拟语气 had I..., 续写强化懊悔）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we fail to ..., the consequences will be ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we fail to act now, the consequences of our indifference will fall not on us, but on the children who inherit this wounded planet. （倡议信条件句+责任转移,增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: every ... carries consequences; the question is not whether ... but ...
